notes: Act 1 locked director's cut, adapted to the resilient pipeline. LTX scenes use vidslide with conformed clips (conform_clip.py makes any clip exactly the scene's frame count; the doc's 'never vidslide' note predates that tool). Durations are director estimates; refit_durations.py --timings rewrites them from measured TTS (offset 1.8 / gap 0.6 / tail 4.5). All transitions are cuts. Scene-01 uses the uploaded title-card art as a static imageslide: its 3 keywordpops were dropped (the boxes already label the terms; full-screen pops covered the title) and the caption was dropped (it covered the boxes). Drift disabled so the card is never cropped.
